I am a 35-year-old woman farming in Tigray with no schooling. My 0.05-hectare maize plot is small, but maize grows well here if I tend it properly. I will buy a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative—just enough to help the crop, because fertilizer is costly and my land is tiny. I will plant local maize seed saved from last season, since improved seed is hard to find and expensive, and my family will do all the work ourselves without hiring labor. We do not have irrigation, and I do not see pests bad enough to warrant chemicals.
